errors.text_span: 可视范围略超出0.2至0.8的区间
errors.evidence: The description states that the visible range of the y-axis 'slightly exceeds the 0.2 to 0.8 interval'. This is misleading. The y-axis visually represents a range from approximately 0 to 1, and the data itself spans from below 0.1 to above 0.9. The description incorrectly describes the axis range by focusing only on the labeled tick marks.
